snippet.title: MotoGP 10/11 trailer!
snippet.description: Moto GP 10/11 will launch on 18 March! Have a quick look at the amazing graphics in motion and thrill to the spectacle of riders stretching their skills to the absolute limits as they seemingly defy the laws of physics!
